scope: local artifact/smoke check only; recorded trajectory completion is independent of official benchmark correctness
command:
set -e
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
cd /tmp/CompCert
./ccomp -version
printf 'int main(void) { return 6*7 == 42 ? 0 : 1; }\n' > /tmp/asbp_smoke.c
./ccomp /tmp/asbp_smoke.c -o /tmp/asbp_smoke
/tmp/asbp_smoke
